author: Matthew Adam
title: Parker Messick K's 9 in Efficient Six for Win
desc: Parker Messick allowed two earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out nine over six innings in Thursday's 4-2 win over Milwaukee.
impact: Messick bounced back from a pair of subpar starts, which saw him allow seven earned runs and strike out eight across 11 1/3 innings. After the win, Messick now has a 2.70 ERA and 1.10 WHIP with a 7-3 record and 91 strikeouts across 15 starts. His next start will be against the White Sox on Tuesday.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Ryan Kreidler cashes in with a two-run blast in Texas
desc: Ryan Kreidler went 1-for-2 in a 9-3 win over the Rangers on Thursday with a home run, a run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Kreidler has been a sporadic lineup name, but he keeps justifying the at-bats when he gets them. After Thursday's win over Texas, Kreidler is hitting .243 with four home runs, 14 RBI, 13 runs scored, a .355 wOBA, and a .265 BABIP across 34 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Trevor Larnach clubs three-hit homer, drives in three
desc: Trevor Larnach went 3-for-5 in a 9-3 win over the Rangers on Thursday with a home run, two runs scored, and three RBI.
impact: Larnach did his best to remind fantasy managers he's not just a platoon placeholder when he's locked in. After Thursday's win over Texas, Larnach is hitting .273 across 61 games with five home runs, 21 RBI, 33 runs scored, and a .349 wOBA.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Luke Keaschall stays pesky in 9-3 win
desc: Luke Keaschall went 2-for-2 in a 9-3 win over the Rangers on Thursday with a run scored, two walks, and one stolen base.
impact: Keaschall kept doing the annoying little things that help teams win, even without a single extra-base hit. After Thursday's win, Keaschall is slashing .252/.335/.333 with two home runs, 24 RBI, 34 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 70 games. He's been hot of late, hitting .300 with one homer, three RBI, and a steal over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Brooks Lee cashes in with a three-run blast
desc: Brooks Lee went 1-for-5 in a 9-3 win over the Rangers on Thursday with a home run, a run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Lee was a mixed bag of contact quality and empty swings lately, but he made the one swing that mattered Thursday. After Thursday's win over Texas, Lee is slashing .238/.294/.423 with 12 home runs, 42 RBI, 32 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 72 games. He's hitting .200 with two homers and four RBI over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Joe Ryan coasts past Rangers for win
desc: Joe Ryan allowed zero earned runs on three hits and two walks while striking out seven over five innings in Thursday's 9-3 win over the Rangers.
impact: Ryan worked around some traffic but kept the Rangers off the board in a tidy outing. After the win, he now has a 2.99 ERA and 1.00 WHIP with a 5-3 record and 99 strikeouts through 16 starts. His next start will come against the Dodgers on Tuesday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kyle Isbel (foot) begins swinging
desc: Kyle Isbel began swinging on Wednesday.
impact: Isbel was diagnosed with a Grade 3 tear of a portion of his left plantar fascia. While he has resumed swinging a bat, he is not expected to begin running for at least a few more weeks. He is projected to return in late July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Carlos Estevez (shoulder) to throw bullpen session Sunday
desc: Carlos Estevez is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Sunday.
impact: Estevez suffered a right rotator cuff strain while rehabbing a foot injury on May 6. He has continued to progress through his throwing program and is scheduled to throw another bullpen session on Sunday. If he avoids any setbacks, he is expected to rejoin the Kansas City Royals' bullpen sometime in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kris Bubic (elbow, shoulder) throws bullpen session Thursday
desc: Kris Bubic threw a bullpen session on Thursday.
impact: Bubic suffered a setback with a shoulder issue following a rehab appearance with Triple-A Omaha on June 9. His MRI came back clean, and he has since completed a bullpen session without issue. However, it remains unclear when he will resume his rehab assignment.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Mears (shoulder) suffers setback
desc: Nick Mears experienced soreness following Tuesday's bullpen session and is undergoing further evaluation.
impact: Mears experienced the same soreness and pinching sensation that landed him on the injured list May 29 with a right shoulder impingement. He had been nearing a minor league rehab assignment, but his next steps will be determined following further evaluation.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) participating in baseball activities
desc: Chicago White Sox manager Will Venable confirmed Munetaka Murakami has begun baseball activities.
impact: Murakami suffered a right hamstring strain on May 29 against the Detroit Tigers and has since progressed to running, throwing and hitting off a tee. Venable said the club plans to gradually increase the difficulty of his hitting work before determining the next steps in his recovery. The manager also noted that Murakami does not have a firm timetable for a return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Trevor Story (hernia) 'progressing pretty nicely'
desc: Boston Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Trevor Story is "progressing pretty nicely," noting that the veteran infielder has resumed jogging at a good pace and has begun taking swings off a tee.
impact: Story underwent sports hernia surgery in late May and appears to be making steady progress in his recovery, having resumed both jogging and swinging a bat. Fantasy managers will need to remain patient; however, as he still has multiple rehab milestones to clear before returning. Story is eligible to be activated from the injured list shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Julio Rodriguez (hamstring) does agility drills, takes BP Thursday
desc: Julio Rodriguez went through agility work and hit in the batting cages on Thursday.
impact: Rodriguez was held out of Thursday's game against the Baltimore Orioles after suffering a left hamstring spasm while making a leaping catch in the sixth inning of Wednesday's 5-3 loss. Encouragingly, he went through agility drills in the outfield with Seattle's training staff before taking batting practice and reportedly moved well throughout the workout. Rodriguez can be considered day-to-day, with his next opportunity to return to the lineup coming on Friday against the Boston Red Sox.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andres Munoz earns save Thursday
desc: Andres Munoz earned his 12th save of the season on Thursday against the Orioles.
impact: Munoz did not allow a hit, but he was able to work around a pair of walks. He has logged a pair of saves so far this week, though his overall struggles to record clean innings have continued.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Woo tosses seven scoreless innings Thursday
desc: Bryan Woo allowed three hits over seven scoreless innings with nine strikeouts and one walk in a win on Thursday against the Orioles.
impact: Woo had allowed just two base runners on a pair of hits through seven scoreless innings. He started the eighth, but was removed following a hit and a walk. He was able to bounce back after struggling against the same Orioles lineup in his previous start.
